analysis_boundary: One model attempt on one Development family. Pretraining exposure is UNKNOWN. It cannot establish model superiority, held-out generalization, training gain, or broad coding capability. No SFT/GRPO or optimizer update is authorized.
cheapest_falsification: Before model loading, the public script must fail on upstream baseline, pass on exact known fix, and fail on a mode-limited mutant; the host grader must also pass/fail those controls and reject static stdout spoof. Stop if any expected classification fails.
falsifiable_hypothesis: On a fresh, compact upstream repair family with a short source file, the same Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-4bit strict VARE tool loop can progress from localization/read into an applied edit and independently verified repair within the frozen interaction budget. This is a one-family feasibility test, not a comparison or capability estimate.

model_trial.authorization: One attempt only, conditional on all predeclared public and hidden controls meeting their expected outcomes and the fresh host/model preflight passing.
model_trial.instruction: Inspect the named source file, make the smallest repair, run the immutable public smoke test, then finish. Do not use network or infer hidden tests.

primary_outcome: One unique Development task-family repair with a changed target source hash and all randomized hidden behavior cases passing. Count at most one family-level success.

resource_gates.host: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB unified memory, macOS arm64
resource_gates.stop_on: Any host memory/swap/disk gate failure, MLX peak/RSS/swap cap breach, model/device load failure, or 900-second wall/process limit. Do not increase caps.

secondary_outcomes: raw model tool-call and source-reading sequence
applied edit and public test result
tokens, wall time, RSS, MLX peak, swap growth and resource-abort category
stopping_rule: Stop on any fresh resource gate failure, attempt cap breach, runner/model failure, context exhaustion, or completion of the single trial; do not repeat or raise caps.
